question: What is the average review score?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) AS average_review_score FROM reviews;

question: How many reviews are there for each review score?
sql: SELECT review_score, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM reviews GROUP BY review_score ORDER BY review_score DESC;

question: What is the average review score for each order status?
sql: SELECT o.order_status, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS average_review_score FROM reviews r JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_status ORDER BY average_review_score DESC;

question: What is the average review score for each customer state?
sql: SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS average_review_score FROM reviews r JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY average_review_score DESC;

question: Which customer states have more than 1000 reviews?
sql: SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM reviews r JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_state HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000 ORDER BY review_count DESC;
